_note: W1a commit 4: the browser frame-rate harness's fixed camera route (tools/web/perf.mjs injects it into the page as window.GLADIUS_PERF_ROUTE; scripts/debug/perf_route.gd flies it; docs/WEB.md "Frame-rate harness"). TOOL DATA, not game data and not a budget: the timings and views are the harness's choice (OQ-WEB-PERF-ROUTE). Coordinates as tools/parity_views.json: pos = [x, z] in map metres, the camera stands eye_m above the terrain under it; yaw_deg is a compass bearing (0 = north = -z, 90 = east = +x), pitch_deg up-positive, fov_deg the vertical FOV. Each view: travel_s = seconds flying from the previous view (smoothstep; arc_m lifts the middle of the flight by up to that many metres so it clears walls and roofs; ignored on the first view), then hold_s = seconds standing at the view. The sum of every travel_s (except the first view's) and hold_s is total_s; the harness's --seconds scales all of them. variant_seeds: a match seed per look variant (data/art_look.json rotation.by_seed, seed modulo 5: 3 = dusk, 2 = storm, 4 = night); seed is the perf runs' seed (dusk). shot_view: the hold the --shots mode screenshots.
_timing_note: W1c step 1 (measurement only; TOOL DATA, not a budget): scripts/debug/perf_route.gd prints a GLADIUS_T frame line (cpu / draw split) for each of the first first_frames frames after the MatchRoot enters the tree, and for any frame of at least long_frame_ms at any time (debug web build + perf=1 only; docs/WEB.md "Stall timing (W1c)").
_action_note: W1c fix pass 1 (measurement only; TOOL DATA, not a budget): after the frame-cap probe, scripts/debug/perf_route.gd makes the match camera current again, waits settle_frames, then runs steps through the player's own input actions (switch = swap_weapon, fire = fire; a fire with the blade is a swing): each press is held hold_frames frames, then the step waits until the view model shows the active weapon (no switch running) plus wait_frames (at most max_wait_frames). GLADIUS_T marks action.camera / action.start / action.switch / action.fire / action.swing / action.end; tools/web/perf.mjs reports the rAF gaps inside action.start .. action.end separately (docs/WEB.md 'Stall timing (W1c)').
